sources.name: USITC EDIS — Section 337 investigations
sources.notes:
Section 337 patent + trademark enforcement investigations: docket
entries, attachments, exclusion orders. Live docket data — treat as
a snapshot at retrieved_at, not a corpus.

sources.name: USITC IDS — IP investigation index
sources.notes:
Investigation-level index of IP proceedings. Lighter-weight surface
than EDIS — useful for cross-investigation discovery before pulling
EDIS attachments.

sources.name: USITC DataWeb — trade statistics
sources.notes:
Trade-stats backend reachable through the shared USITC connector
module, but trade statistics are out of patent-client-agents'
IP-data scope. Kept as ``external`` so the MCP tools that already
ship aren't dropped from the catalog; new IP work should not depend
on this surface.

sources.name: USITC HTS — Harmonized Tariff Schedule
sources.notes:
Tariff-code reference data — out of IP-data scope but shipped via
the shared USITC connector module. ``external`` for the same
reason as DataWeb; do not build new IP tools against it.

INPI France — National Trademarks
sources.issuing_body: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
sources.notes: WIPO ST.66 v1.0. BYOK — production deployers must register a personal data.inpi.fr account. ``cookie_token`` is the closest closed-vocabulary match for INPI's session-bearer + XSRF flow.

sources.name: INPI France — National Designs
sources.issuing_body: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
sources.notes: WIPO ST.86 v1.0. Scope = FR-national only; RCDs covered via EUIPO; Hague international registrations via WIPO Hague. FR patents covered by EPO OPS (INPADOC) — no FR/INPI/Patents row in this manifest by design.

sources.name: PRV Sweden — National Patents
sources.notes: Simple-search + per-record GET (applicationType=NAT default). EP-validated patents reachable via EPO OPS at INPADOC fidelity; this entry covers the SE-national-only slice. SPC search endpoint returned HTTP 500 on probe — deferred to v0.2.

sources.name: PRV Sweden — National Trademarks
sources.notes: Nice classification; dossierTypeEn/Sv discriminates national filings from Madrid IRs designating SE. EUTM coverage via planned EUIPO connector.

sources.name: PRV Sweden — National Designs (Mönster)
sources.notes: Locarno classification; SE-national designs back to 1971. RCDs covered transitively via EUIPO. Hague IR coverage via WIPO Hague.

sources.name: PRV Sweden — Supplementary Protection Certificates
sources.notes: Swedish SPCs (patent-term extensions under EU Reg. 469/2009 + 1610/96). Uses an advanced-search body where each filter wraps as ``{value, searchType}``; the client requires at least one filter because an empty body returns HTTP 500.

sources.name: PRH Finland — National Patents, UMs, SPCs, EP-FI
sources.notes: Search + per-record GET. PatentDossier (national) / PatentDossierUtilityModel (UM) / PatentEurope (EP-FI) / Spc all surface through the same endpoints. Server-side cap of 3,000 rows per query — narrow filters required for high-population applicants. The patent-search body has 30 fields with three inclusion-filter lists (dossierStatus / patentTypes / publicationTypes) supplied with full defaults by the client.

sources.name: PRH Finland — National Trademarks
sources.notes: Nice classification; ~283k national TMs back to 1891. Mark images served at /opendata/trademark/image/... (URL-only on this row; no download surface in v1). EUTM coverage via planned EUIPO connector; Madrid IRs via WIPO Madrid Monitor.

sources.name: PRH Finland — Well-Known Trademarks (TMR)
sources.notes: Marks recognized as well-known in Finland under §6 of the Trade Marks Act (544/2019). ~111 records as of 2026-05-19; each carries a free-text targetGroup audience description. No upstream substitute — FI-national well-known register only.

sources.name: PRH Finland — National Designs (Mallit)
sources.notes: Locarno classification; ~34k national designs back to 1971. RCDs covered transitively via EUIPO. Hague IR coverage via WIPO Hague.

sources.name: USPTO Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes the USPTO HTML schedule (uspto.gov/learning-and-resources/fees-and-payment/uspto-fee-schedule), filters out design + plant patent rows so the patent route covers utility prosecution only. 37 CFR §§ 1.16, 1.17, 1.18, 1.20.

sources.name: USPTO Fee Schedule — Trademarks
sources.notes: Post-2025-rule shape (no entity tiers; paper-filing surcharges modeled via FeeCondition(trigger=paper_filing)). 37 CFR §§ 2.6, 2.7.

sources.name: USPTO Fee Schedule — Designs
sources.notes: Design-specific rows only (filing, search, exam, issue, Design CPA). Shared procedural fees (extensions, appeals, petitions) come from US/USPTO/Fees/Patents.

sources.name: EPO Schedule of Fees — Patents
sources.notes: Sources from the EPO Schedule-of-Fees SPA's backing BFF (fees.apps.epo.org/prod/bff/api/fees). The BFF is undocumented but stable. Covers EPC renewals years 2-20 (codes 732-750) and Unitary Patent renewals (codes 033-050). Amounts in EUR.

sources.name: EUIPO EUTM Fee Schedule
sources.notes: Extracts F-xxx (EUTM) and M-xxx (Madrid) fees from the EUIPO Next.js SSR stream. EUR. 10-year renewal cycle. EUTMR Annex I.

sources.name: EUIPO REUD Fee Schedule
sources.notes: Post-Regulation 2024/2822 reform: back-loaded renewal curve at periods 1/2/3/4 (years 5/10/15/20 = €150/€250/€400/€700), combined application+publication fee, late-payment surcharges abolished.

sources.name: CNIPA Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes the CNIPA English mirror (english.cnipa.gov.cn/col/col3000). Single 2-column hierarchical table with Roman-numeral sections; the scraper expands year-banded annuities (e.g., "1-3 Years (Each Year) | 900") to per-year rows. v1 covers invention patents only; utility-model + design ship as separate routes when needed. Patent Law of the PRC + Implementing Regulations. Fee schedule set by State Council Pricing Bureau.

sources.name: CIPO Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes the CIPO patent fee page (ic.gc.ca/eic/site/cipointernet-internetopic.nsf/eng/wr00142.html). 4 unique HTML tables; small + standard entity tiers in CAD. Maintenance fees use English-band descriptions (e.g., "second, third and fourth anniversaries") which the scraper expands to per-year rows. CIPO publishes annually with a January 1 effective date; Patent Rules SOR/2019-251 Schedule of Fees.

sources.name: DPMA Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scraped from the DPMA cost-info PDF (form A 9510.1) because the English HTML fee page only lists years 3-6 of the annual fee schedule and punts to the PDF for years 7-20. pypdf + regex extraction of the uniform "<6-digit code> <description> ... <amount>" row format. Fee numbers in the 31x range are patents. Statutory basis: PatKostG (Patentkostengesetz).

sources.name: KIPO Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes the KIPO English IP-system fees page (HtmlApp c=92004). KRW. 2-column Description | Fee table with section headers (Application/Examination/Annual/Others). Annuity bands 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12, 13-15, 16-25 years expanded to per-year rows. Per-claim surcharges appear as bare-amount rows after each "a. Basic fee" row and are paired by the scraper. Effective 2023-08-01 per KIPO Enforcement Rule amendment.

sources.name: IP Australia Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes IP Australia's timeframes-and-fees page (13 small Action | Fee tables). AUD. Fees revised 2024-10-01 per the four-yearly fee review; PCT-fee equivalents updated 2026-01-01. v1 GAP: annual renewal fees (years 5-20) live in Schedule 7 of the Patents Regulations 1991 and are not on this page — follow-up scraper needed to pull them from the Federal Register of Legislation.

sources.name: UKIPO Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: UKIPO publishes one gov.uk publication page per patent form (~30 forms). The scraper reads the index detail page (form number/title/sub-URL), then fans out to fetch each sub-page (bounded concurrency 5, hishel cache 7d) and extracts the £-amount from the "Cost" section. Effective 2026-04-01 — first major UKIPO fee rise in years (~25% average). v1 GAP: renewal fees are published as a range (£90-£810); per-year schedule is in The Patents (Fees) Rules 2007 statutory instrument and needs a follow-up scraper against legislation.gov.uk.

sources.name: UKIPO Fee Schedule — Trademarks
sources.notes: Scrapes the gov.uk trade-mark-forms-and-fees detail page; 17 inline Form | Title | Cost tables. Renewals tagged year=10 (UKIPO TM 10-year cycle). Effective 2026-04-01.

sources.name: JPO Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.notes: Scrapes the JPO English fee page (jpo.go.jp/e/system/process/tesuryo/hyou.html). JPY. Patent annuities + examination requests are uniformly claim-count-dependent ("¥X + ¥Y per claim"); the scraper splits each into a base FeeItem plus a separate excess_claims FeeItem with FeeCondition. Year bands 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-25 expanded to per-year rows (Japan has a 25-year term for some patent categories). Two cohorts (current vs legacy by 2004/2019 fee revisions) captured with notes. JPO requires full Sec-Fetch-* browser headers or the request hangs with ReadTimeout — the scraper's HTTP client sets them.

sources.name: IPO India Fee Schedule — Patents
sources.issuing_body: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
sources.notes: Scraped from the canonical Schedule 1 PDF (ipindia.gov.in/frontend/pdf/forms_and_official_fees/Schedule_1.pdf). pypdf + regex extraction. INR. 4 rate columns: small-applicant + other(s) × e-filing + paper. Paper-filing rows flagged via FeeCondition(trigger=paper_filing). All 18 renewal years (3-20) captured cleanly. Main numbered items (filing, exam, etc.) are PDF-structure-sensitive — a sanity check drops rows where rate columns appear misaligned (paper < e-file is impossible), so non-renewal coverage is partial in v1. PCT- specific fees live in Schedule 5 (separate PDF) and ship as a follow-up. Patents Rules 2003 Schedule 1 (as amended through Patents (Amendment) Rules 2024).

sources.name: WIPO PCT — Schedule of Fees
sources.issuing_body: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) — International Bureau
sources.notes: PCT international fees (international filing, supplementary search handling, handling) paid to the WIPO International Bureau, in CHF. Per-RO transmittal and per-ISA search fees vary by Receiving Office and are documented in the PCT Fee Tables PDF — not covered in this route. Source: PCT Schedule of Fees annexed to the Regulations under the PCT (wipo.int/en/web/pct-system/texts/rules/rtax).

sources.name: WIPO Madrid Protocol — Schedule of Fees
sources.issuing_body: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) — International Bureau
sources.notes: Madrid Protocol international trademark fees in CHF: basic application (color/no-color variants), supplementary class fee, complementary designation, subsequent designation, 10-year renewal, irregularity fees. Per-country individual designation fees (set by each Contracting Party) live in a separate 126-row table on wipo.int and are not included in v1. Source: wipo.int/en/web/madrid-system/fees/sched.

sources.name: WIPO Hague System — Schedule of Fees
sources.issuing_body: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) — International Bureau
sources.notes: Hague System international design fees in CHF: basic + per- additional-design, publication, standard designation (3 levels), and per-period renewals (periods 1-5 map to years 5/10/15/20/25). Per-country individual designation fees live in a separate ~50- row table on wipo.int. Source: wipo.int/hague/en/fees/sched.html.

sources.name: TIPO Taiwan — Fees (Patent)
sources.notes: Schedule of Patent Fees (TWD) covering all three Taiwan patent types under one office: invention patents (20-yr term), utility model patents (10-yr term), and design patents (15-yr term). The schedule prints standard rates with sibling SME-tier rows ("natural person, school, or small and medium-sized enterprise") for annuity years 1-3 and 4-6; design year-1 SME annuity is NT$0. Per-claim surcharge over 10 claims (NT$800 invention substantive exam, NT$600 utility model TER); per-50-page surcharge over 50 pages (NT$500). Source HTML table at tipo.gov.tw/en/tipo2/326.html — direct lxml scrape; annuity rows expanded per-year so lookup-by-year works.

sources.name: TIPO Taiwan — Fees (Trademark)
sources.notes: Trademark Fee Standards 2024 (effective 2024-05-01), published as a bilingual zh-TW + EN PDF linked from tipo.gov.tw/en/tipo2/342.html. Per-class fees in TWD for application (NT$3,000), registration (NT$2,500), renewal on 10-year cycle (NT$4,000), opposition (NT$4,000), invalidation (NT$7,000), revocation (NT$7,000), plus per-good surcharge over 20 designated goods (NT$200/good) and per-retail-service surcharge over 5 in Class 35 (NT$500). Scraper uses a curated catalog of 30 entries verified against the live PDF: each entry's English label and amount must co-occur within a 300-char window in normalized text. Drift raises loudly rather than silently mis-classifying.

sources.name: INPI Brazil — Fees (Patent)
sources.notes: INPI Brazil patent fees in BRL covering invention patents (20-yr term), utility model patents (15-yr term), and certificates of addition. Source is the English-language Schedule of Fees PDF at gov.br/inpi/en/costs-and-payment/schedule-of-fees-patents.pdf (the pt-BR landing at /servicos/tabelas-de-retribuicao is Plone role-restricted "Conteúdo Restrito" but the EN PDFs under /en/costs-and-payment/ are anonymously accessible — path discovered 2026-05-19). 60 fee codes expanded to 272 FeeItems via per-year annuity bands × large/small tier siblings. The "discounted" column maps to EntityTier.small per Resolution 251/2019 §I.5 (up to 60% reduction for individuals, micro-enterprises, SMEs, cooperatives, ICTs, non-profits, and public bodies). Statutory basis Lei 9.279/1996 + Ordinance MDIC 39/2014 + ME Ordinance 516/2019 + INPI Resolution 251/2019. v1 GAPS: (a) multi-tier per-claim surcharges published as prose not numeric columns; (b) PCT-section variable-amount rows; (c) Portaria 10/2025 update not yet reflected in the EN PDF.

sources.name: INPI Brazil — Fees (Trademark)
sources.notes: INPI Brazil trademark fees in BRL, per-class for application (pre-approved vs free specification), first 10-year term, 10-yr renewal cycle, opposition, cancellation, and administrative invalidation. Source PDF at gov.br/inpi/en/costs-and-payment/schedule-of-fees-trademarks.pdf. Up-to-60% discount applies per Resolution 251/2019 §I.5. Same scraper-pattern as the patent route.

sources.name: INPI France — Fees (Patent)
sources.issuing_body: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
sources.notes: INPI France patent + utility-certificate + SPC fees in EUR. Source is the "Tarifs des procédures applicables au 27 avril 2026" PDF linked from inpi.fr/ressources/propriete-intellectuelle/tarifs-procedures-et-prestations-de-linpi and fetched via the inpi-block/download-document?id=20516 endpoint (anonymously accessible). Curated catalog of 14 patent entries (filing, search, claims-over-10 surcharge, grant, opposition, SPC) plus per-year annuity rows extracted for years 2-20 + SPC annual fee at year=21. The reduced rate applies to natural persons, non-profit research/education organisations, and companies <1000 employees with <25% non-qualifying capital. Statutory basis CPI Articles R.411-17 et seq.

sources.name: INPI France — Fees (Trademark)
sources.issuing_body: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
sources.notes: INPI France trademark fees per-class (Nice classification) in EUR on a 10-year renewal cycle. Base filing €190 (€350 for collective/guarantee marks); €40 per additional class; €290 renewal per class; €400 opposition; €600 nullity/déchéance. Source is the same procedures PDF as the patent route.

sources.name: INPI France — Fees (Design)
sources.issuing_body: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
sources.notes: INPI France design fees in EUR. Base filing €39 plus per- reproduction surcharges (b&w €23, colour €47). Renewal ('prorogation') €52 per 5-year period (up to 25 years total).
